jcr:content.jcr:title: East Wood, Portishead
jcr:content.jcr:description: A woodland walk with glimpses of the estuary on Portishead's northern edge.
jcr:content.shortDescription: A woodland walk with glimpses of the estuary on Portishead's northern edge.

placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
East Wood brings a wooded landscape close to Portishead's seafront. The terrain rises and falls around Woodlands Road, so a short woodland outing can feel quite different from the nearby Esplanade.

Choose a route from the local walking information and keep the distance flexible. Our family idea: stop at a safe opening in the trees and compare the sounds of the woodland with those coming from the estuary.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families who enjoy hilly woodland walks near the coast.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Woodland paths; combine the visit with seafront facilities if needed.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Plan your start using the local walk guide and observe residential parking restrictions.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Expect slopes, roots and potentially slippery surfaces. Keep to paths and supervise children where the ground drops towards the coast.
